title: Demand/picking quantity reconciliation gap
detection_rule: Aggregate each file first by wave/reference/existing inferred size; never multiply quantities through a row join.
residual_uncertainty: No transaction status, cancellation history or timing alignment proves the gap is failed warehouse service.

title: Picking locations lack matched coordinates
detection_rule: LEFT JOIN stripped picking locations to Storage_Location.originalLocation; retain unmatched.
residual_uncertainty: Unmatched coordinates do not prove invalid locations, lost units or inaccessible physical stock.

title: Published versus extract-volume ABC disagreement
detection_rule: Rank SUM customer units descending, reference ascending for ties; classify using cumulative share BEFORE reference: <80% A, <95% B, else C.
residual_uncertainty: Neither classification is an approved replacement for the other.

title: Unequal SKU inventory across published storage policies
detection_rule: Count nonempty coordinate-retained cells by reference/numeric size per policy under one-cell assumption; compare all six pairs.
residual_uncertainty: Encoded cells are assumed stock units; L1 differences are not observed losses or relocation counts.

title: Stock payload units and snapshot alignment unresolved
detection_rule: README quantity wording conflicts with size-like tokens; neither snapshot timing nor carton/unit equivalence is established.
residual_uncertainty: Existing one-cell-one-assumed-unit and token-as-size rules are retained, not confirmed.

title: Physical scale and floor connectivity unresolved
detection_rule: Published coordinate unit wording and notebook floor conventions do not validate the renderer scale/tier abstraction.
residual_uncertainty: Source units remain source units; no floor transfer, path or physical metric is repaired.

title: Exact repeated Customer_Order records retained
detection_rule: Compare full untrimmed raw tuples, preserve all primary-analysis records; do not deduplicate.
residual_uncertainty: Row equality is confirmed; duplicate transaction identity and deletion eligibility remain unknown.

title: Exact repeated Picking_Wave records retained
detection_rule: Compare full untrimmed raw tuples, preserve all primary-analysis records; do not deduplicate.
residual_uncertainty: Row equality is confirmed; duplicate transaction identity and deletion eligibility remain unknown.

title: Existing inferred customer half-size mapping
detection_rule: Apply only established exact-token customer mapping to /10; retain all other tokens and original source.
residual_uncertainty: Better matching supports an inference; it is not source confirmation.

title: Missing customer sizes retained
detection_rule: Blank stripped size stays empty; never impute or discard.
residual_uncertainty: Missing size semantics and fulfillment eligibility are unknown.

title: Zero-quantity customer records retained
detection_rule: Profile integer quantity without removing zeros.
residual_uncertainty: Zero does not establish cancellation or error.

title: Allocation cells excluded from geometry-dependent analysis
detection_rule: Keep raw cells; exclude only from explicitly geometry-retained counters. Cell selectors are in excluded_cells.csv.
residual_uncertainty: No invented location or actual physical inaccessibility claim.

title: Allocation references absent from published product master
detection_rule: LEFT JOIN cell reference to Product.Reference; no unknown label is silently corrected.
residual_uncertainty: Absence from master does not prove an invalid SKU.

title: Order numbers reused across waves; business identity unresolved
detection_rule: Engine grouping remains waveNumber + orderNumber; profile orderNumber reuse, do not call reuse an invalid ID.
residual_uncertainty: Business completeness across waves is undefined.
